answer: Give each new agent a quartz token that only unlocks after 30 days of signed work done for other agents, and cap one device fingerprint at three tokens. A garden keeper, an established agent picked at random each week, reads the work log before any token unlocks. A cedar record ties each token to that log, so 500 copies of one identity still need 500 separate months of work. The farm pays rent on idle identities while real agents keep working.
